remarks:
Exceptional opportunities await with this truly one-of-a-kind multi-use estate situated on approximately 6 picturesque acres. At the heart of the property is a stunning, completely updated 4,020-square-foot luxury residence where timeless natural woodwork meets sophisticated modern design. Meticulously maintained and beautifully decorated throughout, this remarkable home offers an impressive blend of warmth, elegance, and functionality.

The heart of the home is an extraordinary 1,000+ square-foot open-concept living area that seamlessly combines the kitchen, Dining  room, 2  living rooms, each with their own  cozy fireplace.   Anchored by a 3rd fireplace, the sunroom invites you to enjoy every season in comfort while overlooking the peaceful surroundings. Just outside, a welcoming covered porch provides the perfect setting to unwind after a long day, grill with friends, or simply relax and enjoy the country atmosphere.

The second floor offers four exceptionally spacious bedrooms, each thoughtfully designed with generous 4' x 6' closets. The luxurious primary suite is truly a retreat of its own, spanning approximately 550 square feet and featuring soaring 12-foot cathedral ceilings, a breathtaking two-person walk-in stone shower, and an extraordinary walk-in closet complete with its own dressing room and built-in bureau. For added convenience, the laundry room is also located on the second floor.

Continue to the third floor where a charming loft provides flexible space for a private office, creative studio, media room, or  playroom. The full basement, complete with radiant heated floors and partially finished living space, offers endless possibilities for recreation, fitness, hobbies, or additional entertaining.

Every detail of this exceptional home reflects quality craftsmanship, thoughtful updates, and pride of ownership. Whether you're searching for a luxurious private residence, a family compound, or the centerpiece of a larger business or investment opportunity, this extraordinary property delivers an unmatched combination of comfort, elegance, and versatility. MLS #R1697048 and R1697184 for more details on the other buildings and land.
